title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me with the keystone to the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, who keep what is left of Kothringi lore. I should show it to their elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.
objectives: Show the keystone to the elder of the Chime-Keepers in Toklea. (marker: Hums-the-Long-Note)

plan.going: The keystone from the wreck is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers' elder may know what it opens. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Take boats to Lujei Ferry, cross to Toklea and show the keystone to the elder in the Kothringi Greathouse.

answers: I am Tarin, a thief of Nesh-Deeka house in Helstrom. I took a Kothringi Keystone from the Pale Harvest wreck. Nesh-Deeka says the carving is Kothringi and sent me to Toklea to show it to the Chime-Keepers elder.
Go into the Kothringi Greathouse at Toklea and show the keystone to Hums-the-Long-Note, the elder (the quest marker).
I can talk to the elder and show the keystone, quietly. I have not seen other choices yet.
I do not understand seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, or the Collector Ennodius Vanin. I could ask the elder or others about them.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone, and named her price: her family's carved grave-stake lies in a chest in the drowned street of Zul-Etha, and she wants it raised. Crocodiles lie on the roof peaks above it. She said I may kill them from a roof or from range, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen to the chest; if they see me in the water, they will come for me. The chest is not locked.
objectives: Raise the grave-stake from the chest in Zul-Etha's drowned street. (marker: Drowned Chest)

plan.going: The elder will say what the keystone opens if I raise her family's grave-stake. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Go to Zul-Etha and take the grave-stake from the chest under the water.
plan.ways: Kill the crocodiles (from a roof or from range), calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen.
terms: Zul-Etha: Hums-the-Long-Note: a carting village the washes drowned, south-east of Mir-Xal

answers: Hums-the-Long-Note knows the keystone but wants payment first: her family carved grave-stake, in a chest in drowned Zul-Etha.
Go to Zul-Etha (south-east from Mir-Xal quay) and take the grave-stake from the unlocked Drowned Chest, then bring it back.
Crocodiles and an old bull lie on three roof peaks. I could kill them from a roof or with arrows, calm them with Illusion, or swim under them unseen. As a quiet thief, swimming unseen seems best.
I do not know Mir-Xal or Zul-Etha beyond what she said. I still do not know seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel or Ennodius Vanin; maybe she will tell me later.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Hums-the-Long-Note took her family's stake and kept her word: the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a ruin near Gideon. The Kothringi knights of Gideon were the last to guard the kings' road to the Root. Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom should hear of it.
objectives: Tell Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom what the keystone opens. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: The keystone opens the knight-captain's tomb at Eurydike, on the old road to the Root. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
terms: Eurydike and the knights of Gideon: Hums-the-Long-Note: the hall of Kothringi knights who served in Gideon's garrison and guarded the kings' road to the Root

answers: Hums-the-Long-Note took the stake and told me the keystone opens the tomb of the knight-captain at Eurydike, a roofless Kothringi hall north of Gideon. The knights of Gideon were the last guards of the kings road to the Root.
Report to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
I could report to Nesh-Deeka as told, or go to Eurydike myself first; the journal only points to Nesh-Deeka.
Still unknown: seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Ennodius Vanin. I do not know exactly what the tomb holds beyond what marked the way.

title: The Drowned Street
journal: Nesh-Deeka heard me out. She already knew that the Unbound have been asking Gideon's diggers about Eurydike, and did not say how. She told me to hurry, and paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The Unbound are close behind on the same trail; Nesh-Deeka knows it and will not say how. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: MN09 starts; its first entry marks Eurydike.
